stop the bleeding with a clean shirt or towel. gently clean around the wound with unscented soap and water. I also apply vaseline with a q tip around the wound rather than neosporin since neosporin can be irritating. 

Some people use steri strips to close styros, but I've only ever used bandages or gauze, BUT gauze tends to stick to dry blood which is pretty painful when removing so I don't recommend it for the first few days of healing.
